name: exact-native-frontier-density-v1
purpose: Stress the exact quiescent frontier from sparse to fully nonzero human-cell state.
notes: Every configured reservoir cell remains reachable; density denotes cells seeded with nonzero synaptic current and eligibility immediately before a timed token.
Seeded indices are deterministic and evenly distributed across the population.
Preparation and reset are outside the timed interval; full state scanning, frontier construction, 100 fitted integration steps, and Python-to-native dispatch are inside.
Each frontier result is compared byte-for-byte by SHA-256 with deterministic five-thread dense SIMD from the identical seeded state.
